newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Mir space crew ignores ground protests.
newsitem.headline: Russian Mir space crew ignores ground protests.

text.p: Russian cosmonauts orbiting earth on the Mir space station said they were too busy to join a nationwide day of protest on Thursday by their compatriots on the ground.
"We informed the Mir crew of the nationwide day of action this morning, but the cosmonauts' reaction was very calm," said a spokeswoman for mission control in Korolyev near Moscow.
She said the astronauts had told her: "We have a very busy programme for today."
Two Russian cosmonauts and a U.S. astronaut are currently working on Mir.

The spokeswoman said some of the 1,500 mission control staff might join a demonstration later on Thursday in the centre of Korolyev -- where most residents are space workers -- but that it would be up to them to decide individually whether to take part.
Trade unions and the opposition communists organised the day of strikes and marches to protest against months of delays in wage and pension payments to millions of Russian workers.
